intuition: A valid prefix can add an opening bracket while any remain, and a closing bracket only when it will not unbalance the prefix.

brute_force.approach: Generate all strings of length 2n and retain those with balanced prefixes.

optimal.approach: Backtrack over only valid prefixes, tracking the number of opened and closed pairs.

edge_cases: Zero pairs produce one empty string.
A closing bracket is never added before its matching opening bracket.
